{'text': '洛杉磯道奇隊後備外野手Alex Call在周三以2比6不敵密爾沃基釀酒人隊嘅比賽中冇上陣，但佢喺賽後向轉播美國職棒大聯盟嘅電視台作出重大反擊。', 'context': 'Los Angeles Dodgers reserve outfielder Alex Call didn’t play in Wednesday’s 6-2 loss to the Milwaukee Brewers, but he took a huge swing after the game ― at the networks that broadcast Major League Baseball.'}

{'text': '事件源於喺猶他州經營一間保安公司嘅Taylor Murphy，佢周一深夜喺X平台上發文，投訴比賽期間播出嘅廣告，特別係一則由Megan Fox主演嘅壯陽藥廣告，以及Sydney Sweeney出演嘅含暗示成分嘅體育博彩廣告。', 'context': 'It all started when Taylor Murphy, who runs a security company in Utah, took to X Monday night to gripe about the ads broadcast during the games, specifically an ad for erectile dysfunction pills featuring featuring Megan Fox and an innuendo-laced sports betting commercial with Sydney Sweeney.'}

{'text': 'Murphy嘅帖文引起咗正反兩面嘅關注。', 'context': 'Murphy’s post attracted positive and negative attention.'}

{'text': 'Call同樣對呢個議題感到強烈不滿，佢喺周四凌晨借Murphy嘅帖文向MLB及其電視轉播合作夥伴開火。', 'context': 'Call, who also felt passionate about the issue, used Murphy’s post to call out MLB and its TV partners early Thursday morning .'}

{'text': 'HuffPost已聯絡MLB總部要求回應，但未獲即時答覆。', 'context': 'HuffPost reached out to MLB headquarters for comment, but no one immediately responded.'}

{'text': 'Call並非唯一一位公開批評Sweeney廣告嘅運動員。', 'context': 'Call is not the only athlete who has called out Sweeney’s commercial.'}

{'text': '自從佢為體育預測市場應用程式Novig拍攝嘅廣告上月播出後，多名女性運動員批評該廣告涉及性別歧視同物化女性。', 'context': 'After her ad for Novig, a sports prediction market app, was released last month, various female athletes criticized it for being sexist and objectifying women.'}

{'text': '女性運動員網上平台The Female Athlete Project以以下聲明總結呢種情緒：', 'context': 'The Female Athlete Project, an online platform for female athletes, summed up the sentiment with this statement:'}

{'text': '「我哋唔係完全肯定『Novig』或者Sydney Sweeney同佢嘅公關團隊有冇睇過體育比賽。但老實講，真係難以置信。佢哋竟然可以喺40秒內塞入咁多厭女情結。」', 'context': 'We’re not entirely sure if ‘Novig’ or Sydney Sweeney and her PR team have ever watched sports. But honestly, wow. It’s incredible they could fit so much misogyny in 40 seconds.'}
